QUOTE: `library/common.h:132` — `#define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` | Unconditional for all library translation units. `common.h` is included by `ssl_misc.h`, `ssl_ciphersuites.c`, `md.c`, ... so inside the library `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to plain `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/common.h, a shared header, defines the opt-out for all library translation units, so the private names expand to plain member names.
